facts.business: Poonawalla Fincorp Limited is a Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) offering a diversified suite of 13 loan products catering to salaried and self-employed individuals, professionals, students, MSMEs, and mid-sized corporates.
key_risks: Significant management judgment and assumptions involved in measuring Expected Credit Loss (ECL)
Segmentation of loan book based on common risk characteristics
Staging of loans and determining significant increase in credit risk (Stage 2) and credit-impaired (Stage 3)
Factoring in future macro-economic and industry specific estimates and forecasts
Varied statistical modelling techniques to determine probability of default, loss given default and exposure at default
